## WordPart type

The concrete records and typed nil pointers accepted by upstream syntax.WordPart. Typed nil kinds are limited to this interface's actual implementers; auxiliary records are excluded.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type WordPart =
  | ArithmExp
  | BraceExp
  | CmdSubst
  | DblQuoted
  | ExtGlob
  | Lit
  | ParamExp
  | ProcSubst
  | SglQuoted
  | TypedNil<
      | 'ArithmExp'
      | 'BraceExp'
      | 'CmdSubst'
      | 'DblQuoted'
      | 'ExtGlob'
      | 'Lit'
      | 'ParamExp'
      | 'ProcSubst'
      | 'SglQuoted'
    >;
```
